scripts.predev: npm run build -w @qalahub/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @qalahub/db && npm run build -w @qalahub/db
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c auto "npm run dev -w @qalahub/web" "npm run dev -w @qalahub/api" "npm run dev -w @qalahub/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @qalahub/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @qalahub/db && npm run build -w @qalahub/db && npm run build -w @qalahub/api && npm run build -w @qalahub/worker && npm run build -w @qalahub/web
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @qalahub/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @qalahub/db && npm run build -w @qalahub/db && npm run build -w @qalahub/api && npm run build -w @qalahub/worker
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @qalahub/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @qalahub/db && npm run build -w @qalahub/db && npm run build -w @qalahub/api
scripts.build:worker: npm run build -w @qalahub/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @qalahub/db && npm run build -w @qalahub/db && npm run build -w @qalahub/worker
scripts.start:api: node scripts/validate-production-env.mjs api && npm run start -w @qalahub/api
scripts.start:worker: node scripts/validate-production-env.mjs worker && npm run start -w @qalahub/worker
scripts.test: npm run build -w @qalahub/shared && npm run test -w @qalahub/shared
